newsitem.title: UK: Reed-Elsevier close to Blenheim bid - paper.
newsitem.headline: Reed-Elsevier close to Blenheim bid - paper.

text.p: LONDON, Oct 7 9Reuter) - Publisher Reed-Elsevier is close to making a 450 million stg bid for exhibitions company Blenheim Group, newspaper The Independent said.

Reed-Elsevier is thought to be readying to make an offer of about 480 pence per share after Blenheim on Friday closed at 413-1/2 pence, the newspaper said, citing an unnamed senior source close to the Anglo-Dutch publisher.
But The Independent also quoted a source close to Blenheim as saying Reed-Elsevier was not the only bidder still in the frame. Talk that Reed was interested in buying Blenheim first emerged in July.
